plugins.name: release
plugins.description: Repo-agnostic dev→staging / squash-to-main→production release flow: preflight, deploy-stage, deploy-prod <version> with tag + back-merge. Works with any CI/CD that deploys on push.

plugins.name: flow
plugins.description: Companions for the Flow harness. /flow:linear mirrors .flow/boards/main.yml into a Linear project: status derived from .flow/changes/ + .flow/archive/, new Linear issues pulled back onto the board. Config in .flow/linear.yml.
